query: What is required to maintain Permanent Residence (PR) status?
reference_answer: A Singapore permanent resident (SPR) who wishes to leave Singapore must obtain a Re-Entry Permit (REP) to enable him/her to return to Singapore as a SPR.  A SPR who remains outside Singapore without a valid REP will lose his/her PR status.
answer: To maintain Permanent Residence (PR) status, one must continue to meet the eligibility criteria, such as maintaining lawful presence in the US, and may need to continue to meet any employment or financial requirements set by immigration law. [System]
